claims.quote: polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP), a critical DNA end-processing enzyme,

claims.object_text: decreased activity in the mitochondrial extract of brains of patients with HD
claims.quote: the activity of polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP), a critical DNA end-processing enzyme, is significantly decreased in the mitochondrial extract of brains of patients with HD due to a lower level of fructose-2,6 bisphosphate (F2,6BP)

claims.object_text: decrease in PNKP activity leads to persistent DNA strand breaks refractory to repair completion
claims.quote: Such decrease in PNKP activity leads to persistent DNA strand breaks that are refractory to subsequent steps for repair completion.

claims.object_text: binds F2,6BP and utilizes it as a cofactor
claims.quote: PNKP binds F2,6BP (Kd = 525 ± 25 nM) and utilizes it as a cofactor.

claims.object_text: member of a mitochondrial DNA repair complex
claims.quote: PFKFB3 is part of a mitochondrial DNA repair complex containing HTT, PNKP, DNA Pol γ (POLG), and Lig IIIα.
Activity of PNKP is thus severely decreased in the mitochondrial extract; however, addition of F2,6BP restored its activity.
